items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Krupa -- I know Krupa and Freeman were in that band together.

ctx.x: And he loved this music. There was a fascination between us. We liked each other. And he didn't like what was happening to between Wingy and me. He kept telling me that Wingy was just taking me. I was paying for my musical education, is what he was saying. And of course, in the El Dorado Club after that, we were still together, but this thing was going on underneath.

And it was at the El Dorado that Wingy got into an argument with the boss. And the boss grabbed him and tore his false arm off and threw it across the floor. Arm and coat. And Wingy got up to the band and he says, let's go. We all quit to a man. It was Freeman and the whole band. Krupa -- I know Krupa and Freeman were in that band together. We played the floor show, we played everything. And it was a great experience, great band.
